description: Cumulative layout plus RAW2/HVQ2 dispatcher in unreachable startup alignment padding

entries.note: Delay slot of jal 0x800bffb0: addiu a3,zero,48 becomes addiu a3,zero,64. The frame has x=24, y=86 and height=60; the text labels are drawn at x=36. No branch or target changes.

Bot profile equipment caption: horizontal scale 1.0 to 0.5. Native x=188/y=112 and vertical scale 1.0 remain; sixteen ASCII cells occupy 96 pixels within the right caption box. Only the name draw call changes.
Equipment selection right-column item names: horizontal scale 1.0 to 0.5. Native x=188, row positions and vertical scale 1.0 remain; sixteen ASCII cells occupy 96 pixels.
Gear Set initial equipped-part caption at x=48/y=106: horizontal scale 1.0 to 0.5. Vertical scale, coordinates, gear ID lookup and native draw call remain unchanged; sixteen cells fit in 96 pixels.
Gear Set equipped-part caption during selection at x=48/y=106: horizontal scale 1.0 to 0.5, matching initial view. Vertical scale, positions, ID lookup and draw call are unchanged.

Bot Book biography reader only: horizontal scale 1.0 to 0.5. Four separate native records per entry, x=52, y=166+14*row. Vertical scale stays 1.0; 36 ASCII cells occupy the original 216 pixels. ID calculation and native draw call unchanged.

Save-file A region caption: horizontal scale 1.0 to 0.75. The longest translated region label has ten cells (90 pixels); the original box allows 112. Native x, y=65, vertical scale and region-ID lookup/draw call stay unchanged.

Save-file B region caption: horizontal scale 1.0 to 0.75. The longest translated region label has ten cells (90 pixels); the original box allows 112. Native x, y=65, vertical scale and region-ID lookup/draw call stay unchanged.

Bot Book Height/Weight label only, in one of three native data states: horizontal scale 1.0 to 0.75, so six English cells occupy 54 of the 60 pixels before the numeric field. Vertical scale, positions, value/unit readers and native text call unchanged.
